CustomField.description: The name of the trigger handler and method to bypass (or not). Recommended naming convention: [TriggerHandlerClasss].[MethodName], e.g., AccountTriggerHandler.afterUpdate Note that this field is 255 characters, to account for a possible future change in maximum length allowed by Salesforce.
